title: Regression Error Metrics Specification for MoS2 Contact Resistance

metrics.name: RMSE_log10_dex
metrics.physical_meaning: Penalizes large order-of-magnitude prediction errors; standard optimization loss.

metrics.name: MAE_log10_dex
metrics.physical_meaning: Robust average decade discrepancy; immune to isolated outlier characterization noise.

metrics.name: geometric_factor_error
metrics.physical_meaning: Direct physical interpretability: factor of 1.4x means predictions are within 40% of measured values.

metrics.name: medape_linear_pct
metrics.physical_meaning: Scale-invariant median relative percentage error across linear resistance ranges.
